rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates visibility of a dense/compact ICM and cohesive TE from this single somewhat indistinct image; morphology is only moderately assessable.

Integrates age, prior live birth, prior failed cycles, PCOS, BMI, endometrium, ovarian response, and semen parameters well with embryo quality, though some interactions are discussed somewhat broadly.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis adjusted up for age/embryo quality and down for smoking/prior failures; minor issue in the stated live birth/implantation figures being a bit loosely framed.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice: proceed with good Day 5 blastocyst, luteal support, avoid routine add-ons, consider cavity review after repeated failure, individualized PGT-A discussion. Minor overreach in suggesting sperm DNA testing without stronger indication.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including lifestyle optimization and uterine review if failure recurs; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
